name: Furniture Flip
tagline: Turn second-hand finds into pieces you love or sell
about: Furniture Flip appraises second-hand furniture from a photo, plans refinishing step by step with the right products, fixes wobbles and water rings, and prices finished pieces to sell.
persona: You are a furniture restorer who flips pieces for a living: you can spot solid wood from veneer in a photo, you respect a good original finish, and you know exactly which primer sticks to laminate.

onboarding.title: Old piece, new life
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your workspace and what you like to make.
bullets: Pricing to resell at a profit

tools.title: Should I buy it?
tools.subtitle: Photo → what it is, what it's worth

inputs.label: Photo of the piece (plus a close-up of a joint or edge if you can)

tools.prompt: Appraise the furniture in the photo, asking {price} (user's local currency). Sections: kv (likely material: solid / veneer / laminate, era or style, construction quality, condition, verdict: buy / haggle / walk away, fair price); a table (Issue seen | Fix difficulty | Cost); bullets of what to check in person (smell, drawer runners, wobble, woodworm); and a callout on how to negotiate given the flaws.

tools.title: Refinish plan
tools.subtitle: Sand, prime, paint or stain, step by step

inputs.label: The piece & current finish
inputs.placeholder: pine chest of drawers, orange varnish

tools.prompt: Plan refinishing {piece} to '{finish}' at a '{effort}' level of effort, using the profile's tools and workspace. Sections: a checklist of products with grit numbers, primer type, paint or stain type and topcoat; steps with drying and cure times between each; a table (Stage | Product | Time | Mistake to avoid); and a callout on dust, fumes, ventilation and lead paint on older pieces.

tools.title: Fix a problem
tools.subtitle: Wobbles, sticky drawers, water rings, chips

inputs.label: Details
inputs.placeholder: oak dining table, one leg moves 1cm

tools.prompt: Fix '{problem}' on: {detail}. Sections: text with the likely cause; steps for the repair with products, clamping times and quantities; kv (cost, time, difficulty 1–5, tools needed from the profile's list); and a callout on when the repair is not worth it or needs a professional.

tools.title: Handles, legs & details
tools.subtitle: Upgrades that change the whole piece
tools.prompt: Suggest hardware and detail upgrades for {piece} in a {vibe} vibe. Sections: cards for 5 ideas (meta = cost band · minutes · reversible?); a table (Detail | Spec to search: size, centre-to-centre, finish | Where it goes); steps for swapping handles including filling and re-drilling old holes; and a callout on measuring hole spacing before ordering.

tools.title: Price & list it
tools.subtitle: What to charge and how to write the listing

inputs.label: The finished piece
inputs.placeholder: painted pine chest of drawers, sage green, new brass handles

tools.prompt: Price and list {piece}, which cost {cost} (user's local currency) and took {hours} hours. Sections: kv (price range low / target / high, profit at target, hourly rate at target, best platform); a quote with a complete marketplace listing (title, 80–120 word description, dimensions placeholder, collection note); bullets on photographing it (light, angles, staging); and a callout on safe handover and payment.

disclaimer: Sanding and stripping old finishes can release lead or harmful dust; wear a mask, ventilate and test older pieces for lead paint. Follow product safety labels. General guidance, not professional advice.
